verdict.rationale: Supabase Auth documents its own client SDKs and API endpoints for creating and managing users, and a probe found a published OpenAPI spec, so programmatic access to core auth operations is first-party. Parity with the UI is not shown, though: project-level settings such as the JWT expiry limit are documented only as a field in the dashboard's auth settings. missing for 10: evidence that dashboard configuration (JWT expiry, provider setup, signup toggles) is exposed through an API, an explicit API/UI parity claim, and independent hands-on corroboration of API-only workflows.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: We provide client SDKs and API endpoints to help you create and manage users.
